comments.value:
I too get VRChat stuck when I open a friend location and can't operate it for a while.

It is inconvenient and very troubling.

It seems that the cause and troubleshooting for this bug have been found.

Troubleshoot 1:

Clear Local Profile Data in Debug menu

https://twitter.com/0tdrv_/status/1651807815974125580?s=20

Troubleshoot 2:

Delete "FriendsPerLocation.~~ key" in Windows Registry \HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\VRChat\VRChat

and Reboot Windows

https://twitter.com/nekochanfood/status/1653584216465240064?s=20

Example Video after troubleshooting:

https://twitter.com/nekochanfood/status/1653571687919808514?s=20
So yeah, after deleting the `FriendsPerLocation` keys from my registry, my social menu boosted back up to normal and is useable again.
@{5f2d841622470972dc5795f8|full_name}: be mind, always do backup before touching registry. it risk you not boot whole machine again...
